basic_details.job_title: NITTTR Chandigarh Accounts Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Retired Assistant Accounts Officers, Sr. Accounts Officers, Assistant Audit Officers and Sr. Audit Officers from the Indian Audit & Accounts Department (IA&AD) can apply for the post of Accounts Officer at the National Institute of Technical Teachers Training & Research (NITTTR), Sector-26, Chandigarh, a Deemed to be University under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The engagement is purely on contract for one year (extendable yearly up to the age of 65 years based on performance), at "Last Pay Drawn minus Pension" within the Pay Matrix Level-7 ceiling. important_instructions: The Accounts Officer must follow Institute timings, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM on all working days, and mark attendance on the biometric system on all working days. The Accounts Officer will be required to comply with all rules and regulations the Institute may frame from time to time. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open only to retired officers of the Indian Audit & Accounts Department (IA&AD) who held one of these posts: Assistant Accounts Officer Sr. Accounts Officer Assistant Audit Officer Sr. Audit Officer The notice does not prescribe a separate educational qualification; eligibility rests on retirement from one of the above IA&AD posts. No age limit for applying is printed, but the contract can be extended only up to the age of 65 years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration will be "Last Pay Drawn minus Pension", subject to the maximum ceiling of gross pay to be drawn against the sanctioned position for which hiring is done, which is in the Pay Matrix Level-7 (Rs. 44,900- Rs.1,42,400). The contract is for a period of one year, extendable subsequently on yearly basis upto the age of 65 years based on performance, or till the regular incumbent joins the post. The engagement is purely temporary and does not create any right to claim regularization to this or any other post in the Institute. One casual leave is allowed per month, and casual leaves can be accumulated during the calendar year. TA/DA claims on official tours, if any, will be settled based on the last pay and grade pay drawn by the employee at the time of retirement.

content_sections.text: Fill in the prescribed proforma, giving complete details and experience. Attach self-attested copies of the Pension Payment Order (PPO). Send the application by speed post/ registered post to Dean (Faculty & Staff), National Institute of Technical Teachers Training and Research, Sector-26, Chandigarh-160019. Alternatively, send the application by email to [email protected] or [email protected] . Make sure the application is sent on or before 27/11/2026 till 5:00 pm. The prescribed proforma is not printed in this notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NITTTR Chandigarh Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 27 November 2026 till 5:00 pm.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the NITTTR Chandigarh Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: Only retired Assistant Accounts Officers, Sr. Accounts Officers, Assistant Audit Officers and Sr. Audit Officers from the Indian Audit & Accounts Department (IA&AD) can apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of the NITTTR Chandigarh Accounts Officer?
faq.answer: The remuneration is "Last Pay Drawn minus Pension", subject to the maximum ceiling of gross pay of the sanctioned post in the Pay Matrix Level-7 (Rs. 44,900- Rs.1,42,400).

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the NITTTR Chandigarh Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed proforma with self-attested copies of the PPO, photocopies of testimonials and a latest passport size photograph by speed post/ registered post to Dean (Faculty & Staff), National Institute of Technical Teachers Training and Research, Sector-26, Chandigarh-160019, or by email to [email protected] or [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. Is the NITTTR Chandigarh Accounts Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary on contract for one year, extendable yearly up to the age of 65 years based on performance, or till a regular incumbent joins, and it gives no right to claim regularization.

faq.question: Q6. Up to what age can the Accounts Officer contract be extended?
faq.answer: The contract can be extended subsequently on a yearly basis up to the age of 65 years, based on performance.

faq.question: Q7. How will TA/DA be paid to the Accounts Officer?
faq.answer: TA/DA claims on official tours, if any, will be settled based on the last pay and grade pay drawn by the employee at the time of retirement.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours and leave for the Accounts Officer?
faq.answer: Institute timings are 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM on all working days with biometric attendance, and one casual leave is allowed per month, which can be accumulated during the calendar year.
